post.description:
Score a draft table against a finished season.

The picker calls this rather than reimplementing the rules in TypeScript --
two implementations of the scoring rules is a bug waiting to happen.

get.description:
Where two people agree, and where they disagree most.

Needs no results, so it works from the moment both have filed -- which is
the whole of the season's opening night.
Subscribe to live score, FPL and odds changes for as long as the tab is open.
